title: Flood Shelter Checklist
text: For flood preparedness, review shelter accessibility, sanitation, drinking water availability, staffing rosters, and accessible transportation. Verify all details with local authorities before use.

title: Wildfire Planning Checklist
text: For wildfire planning, review smoke exposure mitigation, evacuation communication channels, responder protective equipment, and air-quality information from official sources.

title: Earthquake Assessment Checklist
text: After earthquake scenarios, coordinate structural safety assessments by qualified engineers, identify blocked roads, and review temporary shelter options.

title: Storm Operations Checklist
text: For storm preparation, review wind alerts, flood-prone crossings, backup power readiness, and official weather bulletins.

title: Resource Allocation SOP
text: Resource allocation proposals must be checked against actual team availability, training, access restrictions, and approvals. Never automatically dispatch teams from model output.

title: Evidence Quality Policy
text: When no relevant evidence is retrieved, abstain from specific operational recommendations and escalate to a qualified coordinator. Cite the source identifier for each retrieved document.

title: Public Communications SOP
text: Draft public communications must be reviewed by authorized personnel and grounded in verified local alerts. Never represent synthetic data as live situational awareness.
